archetypes.name: stall-state-auditor
archetypes.rationale: Durable stall-layer clearing touches multiple state-file contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the stall recovery changes for state-layer ordering, atomicity, and fail-closed behavior. Focus on whether clear-stall can hide a later real stall, partially clear state, or emit success after a validation gap Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ci-token-parity
archetypes.rationale: CI bail tokens now span shell and Python wait and decision paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review CI wait and decide token normalization across scripts/ci-wait.sh, python/ci_monitor.py, python/ci.py, and tests. Focus on parity, backward-compatible transient handling, and whether human diagnostics remain separate from machine tokens Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
